media.title: Giuliano Pomeranz — portrait photograph
media.altText: Portrait photograph of the organist Giuliano Pomeranz.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The Saint Petersburg Philharmonia page identifies the sitter as Giuliano Pomeranz but supplies no photographer, photograph date, original publication or open reuse licence. The local 980 × 1240 pixel reproduction is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with the institutional source and unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
media.publicCaption: Portrait of Giuliano Pomeranz, the organist documented in Kaper’s First Piano Quartet circle under the name Julian Pomeranc.
